clips.title: The story
paras: Glorin Steelbrow is a dwarven operative found drinking at the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor. Acting as an associate of Bishop Farthing of Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, he helps adventurers investigate the lost Third Fleet and recover sacred relics and materials scattered across the Wetlands coast. His efforts tie the haunted wilderness of Duskwood directly to the sunken shipwrecks of the north.

While Bishop Farthing aids the people of Duskwood against its creeping terrors from Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, he maintains ties far to the north in Menethil Harbor. Stationed inside the bustling Deepwater Tavern, Glorin Steelbrow acts as Farthing's eyes and hands on the coast. He offers aid and direction to travelers sent north in search of sacred metals and forgotten relics, providing a crucial bridge between the troubles of the southern forest and the sunken wreckage of the Wetlands.
